title: Why Franklin Clinton really left the hood in GTA 5
subject: franklin
description:
Would you have gotten in the car with Michael? 👇

How a repo man from Forum Drive met the man who changed his life. Spoilers for Grand Theft Auto V.

scenes.text: Franklin Clinton was 25 and still repossessing cars in Los Santos.
He grew up on Forum Drive in Strawberry, raised by his grandmother.
His boss, the Armenian dealer Simeon Yetarian, sold cars on credit buyers could never pay.
In the mission Complications, Franklin went to a Rockford Hills mansion to take a rich kid's car.
Michael De Santa was hiding in the back seat with a gun.
He made Franklin drive straight through the window of Simeon's showroom.
Franklin lost his job that day, and met the man who would get him out.
